<h1 style="font-size: 3rem;">ALOHA! </h1>

<br>

I am a data scientist, inspired by my Hawaiʻi community, where the relationship between the land and people fuels my passion to protect the environment I grew up with. Through my work I aim to use the intersection of technology and tradition to create data-driven solutions to the environmental challenges we face.

<br> **Explore my website to learn more about me and the things I do!**

:::
